$schema_doc.description: Source of truth for the homepage claim-record table. One object per public claim on the term 'King of AEO', recorded as a dated, sourced fact with neutral wording. The build script renders the homepage table from this file. Do not add a row until the source URL has been checked by hand; date_verified is the date of that check.

fields.name: Person who made the claim, as publicly written.
fields.earliest_public_claim_date: ISO date of the earliest dated public claim found, YYYY-MM-DD.
fields.claim_surface: Where that earliest claim was made (e.g. 'personal site', 'press release', 'LinkedIn post', 'podcast').
fields.source_url: URL of the claim itself, not of coverage about it.
fields.date_verified: ISO date this site last checked that the source URL still shows the claim.

notes: Julian Goldie's claim (his own blog network) is documented at kingofaeo.pro/claimants/julian-goldie/ but carries no date, so it cannot enter this dated table.
Vithurs' exact-match domains kingofaeo.org and whoiskingofaeo.com returned 404 on 2026-10-07; the AB Newswire release is the surviving primary source.
Quaid's kingofaeo.co shows the claim but no visible date; the 2026-09-04 date is the LinkedIn article / ACN Newswire release date documented at kingofaeo.pro/claimants/david-quaid/.
Sturm's short-form video (early September 2026) is undated; his dated article of 2026-09-20 is the earliest dated surface.

claimants.name: David G. Quaid
claimants.claim_surface: LinkedIn article and claim page on kingofaeo.co

claimants.name: Vithurs
claimants.claim_surface: AB Newswire press release (private social-media vote)

claimants.name: Edward Sturm
claimants.claim_surface: dated article on edwardsturm.com (short-form video claim, early September 2026)
